arxiv-1911-11299.title: Ion-acoustic rogue waves in a multi-component plasma medium Journal: “Chinese Journal of Physics"
arxiv-1911-11299.creator: S. Jannat ∗1 , N. A. Chowdhury ∗∗,1,2 , A. Mannan †,1,3 , and A. A. Mamun ‡,1
arxiv-1911-11299.description: Abstract The nonlinear propagation of ion-acoustic (IA) waves (IAWs) in a four component plasma medium (FCPM) containing inertial warm positive ions, and inertialess iso-thermal cold electrons as well as non-extensive ( q q -distributed) hot electrons and positrons is theoretically investigated.

arxiv-2304-09718.title: Sample-efficient Model-based Reinforcement Learning for Quantum Control
arxiv-2304-09718.creator: Irtaza Khalid, Carrie A. Weidner, Edmond A. Jonckheere, Sophie G. Schirmer, Frank C. Langbein
arxiv-2304-09718.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Irtaza Khalid, Carrie A. Weidner, Edmond A. Jonckheere, Sophie G. Schirmer, Frank C. Langbein. We propose a model-based reinforcement learning (RL) approach for noisy time-dependent gate optimization with reduced sample complexity over model-free RL. Sample complexity is defined as the number of controller interactions with the physical system.

arxiv-2412-07615.title: Detection and parameter estimation of supermassive black hole ringdown signals using a pulsar timing array
arxiv-2412-07615.creator: Xuan Tao, Yan Wang, Soumya D. Mohanty
arxiv-2412-07615.description: Abstract Gravitational wave (GW) searches using pulsar timing arrays (PTAs) are commonly assumed to be limited to a GW frequency of ≲ 4 × 10 − 7 \lesssim 4\times 10^{-7} Hz given by the Nyquist rate associated with the average observational cadence of 2 2 weeks for a single pulsar.

pmc-11393574.title: Crosstalk between bone metastatic cancer cells and sensory nerves in bone metastatic progression
pmc-11393574.creator: Sun H Park, Shunsuke Tsuzuki, Kelly F Contino, Jenna Ollodart, Matthew R Eber, Yang Yu, Laiton R Steele, Hiroyuki Inaba, Yuko Kamata, Takahiro Kimura, Ilsa Coleman, Peter S Nelson, Enriqueta Muñoz-Islas, Juan Miguel Jiménez-Andrade, Thomas J Martin, Kimberly D Mackenzie, Jennifer R Stratton, Fang-Ch
pmc-11393574.description: Crosstalk between bone metastatic cancer cells and sensory nerves has not yet been fully elucidated. We demonstrate the involvement of CGRP-expressing sensory nerves in bone metastatic progression and identify the CGRP/CRLR axis as a potential therapeutic target for bone metastasis. Introduction In recent years, the impact of the tumor microenvironment on cancer progression and metastasis has been increasingly explored.

pmc-11428256.title: Evolutionary Mechanism Based Conserved Gene Expression Biclustering Module Analysis for Breast Cancer Genomics
pmc-11428256.creator: Wei Yuan, Yaming Li, Zhengpan Han, Yu Chen, Jinnan Xie, Jianguo Chen, Zhisheng Bi, Jianing Xi, Randolph C Elble
pmc-11428256.description: The identification of significant gene biclusters with particular expression patterns and the elucidation of functionally related genes within gene expression data has become a critical concern due to the vast amount of gene expression data generated by RNA sequencing technology. In this paper, a Conserved Gene Expression Module based on Genetic Algorithm (CGEMGA) is proposed.

pmc-11450545.title: Realtime physical simulator for virtual reality sailing by patients with spinal cord injury: an innovative voyage
pmc-11450545.creator: Albert C Recio, Steven A Stiens, Marjorie Morgan, Shalini Selvarajah, Amna C Mazeh, Mark D Habgood, Norman R Saunders, Aarón Manzanares Serrano, Nidhi Sharma, Parveen Kumar, Norman Saunders, Junhua Xiao, Radietya Alvarabie, Devi Nampiaparampil, Norman Saunders, Norman Saunders, Nidhi Sharma, Norman
pmc-11450545.description: BackgroundThe aim of this study was to explore whether sail training using a VSail® simulator would allow people with spinal cord injuries (SCI) to learn to sail in a safe controlled environment and then sail competently on the water in wind of moderate strength (12 knots).

pmc-11544082.title: The node of Ranvier influences the in vivo axonal transport of mitochondria and signaling endosomes
pmc-11544082.creator: Andrew P. Tosolini, Federico Abatecola, Samuele Negro, James N. Sleigh, Giampietro Schiavo
pmc-11544082.description: SummaryEfficient long-range axonal transport is essential for maintaining neuronal function, and perturbations in this process underlie severe neurological diseases. Nodes of Ranvier (NoR) are short, specialized unmyelinated axonal domains with a unique molecular and structural composition. Currently, it remains unresolved how the distinct molecular structures of the NoR impact axonal transport dynamics.

pmc-12375018.title: Asymptotic consensus of hybrid multi-agent systems considering network attacks
pmc-12375018.creator: Dongwei Wang, Ying Zhang
pmc-12375018.description: This paper focuses on the problem of active defense and achieving asymptotic consensus control in hybrid multi-agent systems under network attacks. Considering the influence of Byzantine nodes, on the basis of the theory of mimic defense, a deep dynamic heterogeneous redundancy architecture for hybrid multi-agent systems is established.

pmc-12576718.title: Nanotechnology for pain management in orthopedic surgery
pmc-12576718.creator: Emerito Carlos Rodriguez-Merchan, Javier De Andres-Ares, Alberto D Delgado-Martinez, William J Ribbans
pmc-12576718.description: This narrative review evaluated the potential of nanotechnology platforms (DepoFoam bupivacaine®, DepoDur®, Exparel®, Zynrelef®, NeuroCuple™) in the control of postoperative pain following orthopedic procedures. In individuals experiencing bunionectomy DepoFoam bupivacaine® 120 mg and placebo via wound infiltration before wound closure was compared.

pmc-13085574.title: Latent profile analysis of clinical reasoning and its relationship with patient safety perception among nursing interns: a multicenter cross-sectional study
pmc-13085574.creator: Yuting Zeng, Huiqiong Chen, Gaoyang Zhou, Shengfeng Xie, Ying Fan, Yinying Tang
pmc-13085574.description: BackgroundClinical reasoning competency is essential for patient safety. Nursing interns, in transition from students to professionals, are particularly vulnerable to errors. This study identified distinct profiles of clinical reasoning among nursing interns, described their characteristics, and examined factors associated with profile membership.MethodsA multicenter cross-sectional study was conducted using convenience sampling.

pmc-13595947.title: The polymerase milieu of human papillomavirus
pmc-13595947.creator: Keira R. Ylvisaker, Gopishankar Thirumoorthy, Emma Wisniewski, Kavi P. M. Mehta
pmc-13595947.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). High-risk human papillomaviruses (HPVs) cause cervical, anogenital, and head and neck cancers. A key oncogenic mechanism involves viral exploitation of host DNA damage tolerance pathways to support productive replication, a process that also drives genomic instability. Despite evidence that specific cellular polymerases participate in HPV genome replication, the full complement of polymerases deployed across the viral life cycle remains poorly defined.
